title: Common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by every Kibbly schema.

id.description: Document id. Firestore auto ids in production; readable ids such as dog_biscuit in examples.

timestamp.description: A moment in time, always UTC, ISO 8601, whole seconds. Example: 2026-11-09T07:00:00Z

local_date.description: A calendar day in the home timezone. Example: 2026-11-09

local_time.description: A clock time in the home timezone, 24 hour. Example: 08:00

grams.description: An amount of dry kibble in whole grams.

confidence.description: Recognition confidence from 0 to 1. The app shows it as a percentage.

url.description: A Firebase Storage or HTTPS link.
